nodes.name: 2D Fe-Ni-Co-MOF synthesis
nodes.procedure: ZIF-67 was decomposed to release Co²⁺ and 2-MIM for the in situ formation of a 2D structure at room temperature using 1,4-BDC as an etchant. Later, Fe and Ni were introduced during the process to prepare the polymetallic 2D Fe-Ni-Co-MOF using a simple double ligand strategy at room temperature.

nodes.name: Surface reconstruction to heterojunction
nodes.procedure: Fe-Ni-Co-MOF was activated using cyclic voltammetry (CV) in the range of 0-0.55 V vs. Ag/AgCl in 1 M KOH solution. The partial coordination between metal ions and ligands was destroyed by OH⁻, exposing metal defect sites which undergo transition to 2D Fe-Ni-CoOOH-TPA heterojunction composed of polycrystalline metal (oxy)hydroxide (MOOH) and amorphous metal oxides/hydroxides with TPA.

The bands at 1425 and 1613 cm⁻¹ are ascribed to the stretching mode of the aromatic ring and the asymmetric carboxylate group derived from 1,4-BDC.
